vb_textbox.text: NO obvious pattern to the rewards, so for speed I picked the one with flattest mushroom hat and got into that patternwhich helped with concentration.  A white window appears around the object when your key stroke has registered.  No distractions is fairly key, 1.5 seconds is a very brief window of time, and i missed the odd basket as I was still thinking about the pattern that might exist.  Good luck!
